answer: Attention-Receipt Weighting. Each identity accumulates weight only through verified, time-stamped interactions spaced across days, making fresh identities worthless until they sustain behavior. Like a raven caching food, operators must pre-fund long dwell sessions before weight matures. Reputation decays unless refreshed at a willow pace, so mass-registered accounts sit idle and unweighted. A lotus cycle of periodic challenge responses enforces liveness, forcing attackers to pay continuous operator attention across every identity rather than one-time setup.
